about_the_game:
Wizard's Tower is an RPG Sounds pack of looping music, ambient sounds, and SFX. It includes:

Music
  • Wizard Crystal
  • Spellcaster
  • Up The Ladder

SFX
  • Chest Open (6)
  • Magic Complex Riddle Mechanism (3)
  • Magic Net Catch (6)
  • Magic Net Fail (6)
  • Simple Riddle Mechanism (4)
  • Magic Trapdoor (4)
  • Mimic Chest Bite (4)
  • Mimic Chest Open (4)
